FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    enable : BOOL;

    sensorValid : BOOL;
    setpoint : REAL;
    temperature : REAL;

VAR_OUTPUT

VAR

    historyValid : BOOL := FALSE;
    resetPrev : BOOL := FALSE;
    resetRising : BOOL;

fault := NOT sensorValid OR scanSeconds <= 0.0 OR scanSeconds > 10.0;
resetRising := resetBtn AND NOT resetPrev;

END_IF;

```

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    enable : BOOL;
    resetBtn : BOOL;
    sensorValid : BOOL;
    setpoint : REAL;
    temperature : REAL;
    scanSeconds : REAL;
    bias : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    power : REAL;
    correction : REAL;
    fault : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    ePrev : REAL := 0.0;
    historyValid : BOOL := FALSE;
    resetBtnPrev : BOOL := FALSE;
    resetRising : BOOL;
    e : REAL;
    de : REAL;
    x : REAL;
    y : REAL;
    mN_x : REAL;
    mZ_x : REAL;
    mP_x : REAL;
    mN_y : REAL;
    mZ_y : REAL;
    mP_y : REAL;
    weightSum : REAL;
    weightedCentroid : REAL;
END_VAR

fault := NOT sensorValid OR scanSeconds <= 0.0 OR scanSeconds > 10.0;
resetRising := resetBtn AND NOT resetBtnPrev;

IF NOT enable OR fault OR resetRising THEN
    power := 0.0;
    correction := 0.0;
    ePrev := 0.0;
    historyValid := FALSE;
ELSE
    e := setpoint - temperature;
    x := LIMIT(-1.0, e / 10.0, 1.0);

    IF NOT historyValid THEN
        de := 0.0;
    ELSE
        de := (e - ePrev) / scanSeconds;
    END_IF;

    y := LIMIT(-1.0, de / 2.0, 1.0);

    mN_x := MAX(-x, 0.0);
    mZ_x := 1.0 - ABS(x);
    mP_x := MAX(x, 0.0);

    mN_y := MAX(-y, 0.0);
    mZ_y := 1.0 - ABS(y);
    mP_y := MAX(y, 0.0);

    weightSum := (mN_x * mN_y) + (mN_x * mZ_y) + (mN_x * mP_y)
               + (mZ_x * mN_y) + (mZ_x * mZ_y) + (mZ_x * mP_y)
               + (mP_x * mN_y) + (mP_x * mZ_y) + (mP_x * mP_y);

    weightedCentroid := (mN_x * mN_y * -30.0)
                      + (mN_x * mZ_y * -20.0)
                      + (mN_x * mP_y * -10.0)
                      + (mZ_x * mN_y * -10.0)
                      + (mZ_x * mZ_y * 0.0)
                      + (mZ_x * mP_y * 10.0)
                      + (mP_x * mN_y * 10.0)
                      + (mP_x * mZ_y * 20.0)
                      + (mP_x * mP_y * 30.0);

    IF weightSum <= 0.0 THEN
        correction := 0.0;
    ELSE
        correction := weightedCentroid / weightSum;
    END_IF;

    power := LIMIT(0.0, bias + correction, 100.0);

    ePrev := e;
    historyValid := TRUE;
END_IF;

resetBtnPrev := resetBtn;
